description: This 3D model depicts a set of outdoor stairs leading up to a platform, with a railing on the platform and a single vertical post. The stairs are constructed from wooden planks with a golden hue, suggesting they might be made of oak or a similar warm-toned wood. The steps are evenly spaced and appear to be sturdy, designed for safe ascent and descent. The platform itself is a flat, grey surface, possibly concrete or stone, providing a stable area at the top of the stairs. A railing, also in a golden wood tone, surrounds a portion of the platform, offering support. A solitary grey post rises vertically from the platform, its purpose unclear but potentially for lighting or structural support. The entire structure is set on a larger grey, flat base, resembling a foundation or a paved area.
